message: The type '{0}' does not contain any template member named '{1}'. Check the template name, for instance by using the 'nameof' operator.
title: The type does not contain a template member of the given name.
rationale: TemplateNameValidator.ValidateTemplateName reports the diagnostic only when no member of the given name exists; duplicate names are reported earlier by LAMA0032, so 'must have exactly one member' is misleading. The title refers to the obsolete term 'dynamic advice' and is not a short sentence.
